concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-cards]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service guide for one-off/recurring third-party Mastercard/Visa payouts via Transfers API, with region/currency matrix, optional zero-auth and PCI-dependent tokenization; 30-minute availability is issuer-dependent, not guaranteed.
warnings: Support table is dated; one-off eligibility check is optional, tokenization is required only under the stated PCI condition, and a transfer request or card-network acceptance is not cardholder receipt.
